questions.statement:
**ID:** `UNI-ENG-08-analytical-reading-001-v1`

ID: UNI-ENG-08-analytical-reading-001-v1

### Contexto
**Survey Results (Favorite Pets):**
- Dogs: 50%
- Cats: 30%
- Birds: 15%
- Others: 5%

options.text: Half of the people prefer dogs.
